newsitem.title: USA: Ford to sell Budget to Team Rental.
newsitem.headline: Ford to sell Budget to Team Rental.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Tuesday it agreed to sell Budget Rent a Car Corp to Team Rental Group Inc in a transaction valued at about $350 million.
Budget, together with its independent licensees, is the world's fourth largest rental car business.

"In light of investor interest in the entire rental car industry, we concluded that it is now in the best interests of Budget and Ford if Team Rental, Budget's largest franchisee, were to acquire Budget. It's a good fit," said Ed Hagenlocker, Ford vice chairman, in a statement.

Team Rental owns and operates 13 Budget franchises with a total of 155 locations, leases vans for commuter pooling in 22 states, and also markets retail used vehicles. Team has an annualized revenue base exceeding $370 million.
Ford will continue as a major supplier of cars and trucks to Budget's fleet.
The transaction announced today also includes a new vehicle supply arrangement between Ford and Budget.

On January 9, Ford said it was reviewing strategic options for Hertz Corp which could include a partial sale of the industry's largest rental car company. Hagenlocker said then that it is premature to determine whether any actions concerning Hertz will occur, or if they do, when they would occur.
Ford had acquired all of Hertz in 1994.
Shares of Ford closed at 33-1/4, while shares of Florida-based Team Rental closed at 23-1/2.
